data.name: Hadiah
data.gender_notes: Hadiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gift from Allah, a blessing, a reward for good deeds. The name Hadiah carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hadiah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blessings and rewards from Allah for good deeds and righteousness.
data.etymology: Hadiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadiah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: حدية
in_arabic.long_meaning: هدية (حدية) يعني هدية أو ثواب. هدية هي ما يتمم العطاء به حتى يتمكن الشائع من تحقيق ما يحتاجه له.

in_urdu.name: ہدیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہدیہ (ہدیہ) اعنی ہدیتہ یا ثواب. ہدیتہ ایسے ماترات میں ہوتی ہے جس کا حاجت شائع نہیں پاتا ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: हदिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: हदिया (हदिया) अर्थात हदिया या थोदी है। हदिया के अवसर पर दिया जाने वाला दونوں چीजें साथ हैं।

in_pashto.name: هدیه
in_pashto.long_meaning: هدیه (هدیه) نوعی هدیته یا ثواب ہوتی ہے.

in_english.name: Hadiah
in_english.long_meaning: A precious gift from Allah, a blessing, a reward for good deeds.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hadiah in Islamic culture represents a precious and valuable gift. It is often used to refer to an offering, a present, or a reward given for good deeds or achievements. The exchange of Hadiyah (gifts) is also a significant custom during special occasions such as weddings, Eid-ul-Fitr, and births.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, the name Hadiah holds great spiritual significance as it signifies a blessing or reward from Allah. It symbolizes the belief that every good thing that comes into one's life, including gifts, opportunities, and blessings, ultimately derives from Allah. Therefore, the name Hadiah serves as a reminder to remain grateful for Allah's blessings and to strive towards doing good deeds to earn more rewards from Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift" symbolizes A precious gift from Allah, a blessing, a reward for good deeds.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hadiah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, vol. 8, p. 232 The name Hadiah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her generosity and kindness.
